name: Marko Vešligaj - § 10/1
title: REPORT on the Gender Equality Strategy 2025
part_text: Text as a whole without the words: ‘, including due to law enforcement practices’ and ‘mandatory,’
part_context: Underlines that marginalised groups face a heightened risk of violence and that intersecting forms of discrimination intensify the effects of GBV and re-victimisation<del>, including due to law enforcement practices</del>; calls on the Commission, therefore, to develop and, in cooperation with the Member States, implement mandatory, comprehensive training for all legal professionals, including judges and prosecutors, on issues related to GBV, intersectionality and victim support to ensure that legal professionals are adequately equipped to handle cases, both offline and online, in a gender sensitive and intersectional manner and to ensure that victims are not subject to secondary victimisation during legal proceedings;
